Young Economist Network · Australia

Your next step in economics.

A guide for Australian economists and economics-related professionals under 30, including students, graduates and people with several years of experience. Explore economics, analysis, research, policy, consulting, evaluation, regulatory and finance work, including suitable specialist, management and leadership roles, alongside student pathways across Australian and international organisations.

Under 30 describes this guide's audience. Each opportunity has its own qualification, experience, work-rights and other eligibility requirements; an employer age limit applies only when explicitly stated.

Organisation coverage is being researched. Verified opportunities will appear after their application status is checked.
